name: Noir Gym
tagline: Log workouts, chase PRs, and grow your Fitness Score with every rep.
blurb: Noir Gym is a premium, no-fluff workout log for lifters who want more than a spreadsheet.
description:
Noir Gym is a premium, no-fluff workout log for lifters who want more than a spreadsheet. Every set you log builds a real training profile — from your rep history to a full Fitness Score that grows as you do.

💪 LOG YOUR TRAINING
Record any exercise with weight, sets, and reps in seconds. Pick a muscle group, save your set, and roll straight into a built-in rest timer (45s / 60s / 90s presets) so you never lose momentum between sets.

📈 WATCH YOUR PROGRESS
Pick any exercise and see its full weight curve over time. Noir Gym automatically tracks your personal records and celebrates the moment you set a new one.

🏆 FITNESS SCORE & LEVELS
A six-axis score — Consistency, Strength, Endurance, Habits, Progress, and Volume — calculated straight from your real training history and visualized on a radar chart. Earn points for every workout, every PR, and every streak day, and level up as your profile grows.

🔥 STREAKS & TRAINING SUMMARY
See your current streak, total workouts, total training volume, and exactly which muscle groups you've been hitting hardest, all summarized in one place.

🎯 BULK OR CUT
Set your current goal — Bulking or Cutting — to keep your training aligned with your phase.

📋 A FULL HISTORY, FILTERED YOUR WAY
Browse your complete workout log and filter it by month, year, or muscle group. Clean up old entries one at a time or in bulk whenever you want a fresh start.

📤 YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything is stored on your device — no account, no sign-up. Export your full training history whenever you like, and import it back on any device.

🌙 DESIGNED TO FEEL PREMIUM
A sleek dark "noir" interface (with a light mode if you prefer), full Arabic and English support with proper right-to-left layout, and an installable app that works offline, straight from your home screen.

Your consistency writes the score. Log your first set and start building yours. 💪
